title: Quadruple S-R latches

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book 2nd ed. 1976, SN54279/SN74279: pin assignment and function table on page 5-60; recommended conditions, electrical and switching characteristics on pages 6-60 and 6-61

functions.text: Each output is its latch's stored bit (two cross-coupled NAND gates). For latches 1 and 3, S' means both S' inputs: S'=H when both are high, S'=L when one or both are low.

state.changesOn: levels on S' and R' (no clock)
rules: S'=L, R'=L: Q = H, pseudo-stable: it may not persist when S' and R' return to high
Latches 1 and 3: S' is low when either S1' or S2' is low

electrical.notes: SN74279: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Diode-clamped inputs, totem-pole outputs.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm

unknown: The datasheet lists tPHL from S' (9/15 ns) without saying which condition makes S' drive Q low; recorded as printed.
